working_definition: Adult fat cells of the pericerebral fat mass surrounding the brain in the head (FCA head, 5-day adults); authors' FBbt term is the structure adult pericerebral fat mass.

justification: Authors' term FBbt:00048409 (adult pericerebral fat mass) is a structure; the cell-level equivalent defined as fat cell part of that mass is adult pericerebral fat cell.
